name: paybox-kreopoly-lens
description: On-chain Polymarket intelligence + trade execution for AI agents. Track wallets, read positions, and place bets through PayBox's non-custodial signing layer.

requires_credentials.description: Polygon wallet used to read positions and (optionally) sign Polymarket CTF Exchange trades.

cost_model.notes: Reads are free (Polygon RPC). Trade execution uses PayBox's native request_wallet_sign and may incur gas + Polymarket fees.
